code:
def balanced(P, C):
    q, r = divmod(P, C)
    return [q + 1] * r + [q] * (C - r)


def sticky_move(P, C_old, C_new, old_assign):
    """Eager/Cooperative 共用：算出最小搬迁的分配方案，返回 (新分配, 搬迁分区数)。"""
    lo = P // C_new
    hi = -(-P // C_new)
    new_assign = [[] for _ in range(C_new)]
    pool = []
    for i in range(min(C_old, C_new)):
        hold = sorted(old_assign[i])
        new_assign[i] = hold[:hi]
        pool.extend(hold[hi:])
    # 有消费者低于 lo 时，从持有最多的消费者回收
    deficit = sum(max(0, lo - len(new_assign[i])) for i in range(C_new))
    if deficit > 0:
        donors = sorted([i for i in range(C_new) if len(new_assign[i]) > lo],
                        key=lambda i: (-len(new_assign[i]), i))
        for i in donors:
            while len(new_assign[i]) > lo and deficit > 0:
                pool.append(new_assign[i].pop())
                deficit -= 1
            if deficit == 0:
                break
    for i in range(C_new):
        while len(new_assign[i]) < lo and pool:
            new_assign[i].append(pool.pop(0))
    pool.sort()
    for p in pool:
        cands = [i for i in range(C_new) if len(new_assign[i]) < hi]
        if not cands:
            break
        idx = min(cands, key=lambda i: (len(new_assign[i]), i))
        new_assign[idx].append(p)
    old_owner = {}
    for i, ps in enumerate(old_assign):
        for p in ps:
            old_owner[p] = i
    new_owner = {}
    for i, ps in enumerate(new_assign):
        for p in ps:
            new_owner[p] = i
    moved = sum(1 for p in range(P) if old_owner.get(p) != new_owner.get(p))
    return new_assign, moved


P = 12
C_OLD = 4
old_assign = [list(range(i * 3, i * 3 + 3)) for i in range(C_OLD)]

print("=== 场景：%d 个分区 / %d 个消费者，扩容到 5 个、6 个消费者两种情形 ===" % (P, C_OLD))
print("旧分配:", [(i, v) for i, v in enumerate(old_assign)])
print("旧负载:", [len(v) for v in old_assign])
print()

print("%-16s %-26s %-16s %s" % ("协议", "新负载分布", "停摆分区数", "停摆占比"))
print("%-16s %-26s %-16d %s" % ("Eager（旧）", "全体放弃全部分区", P, "100.0%"))
for C_NEW in (5, 6):
    new_assign, moved = sticky_move(P, C_OLD, C_NEW, old_assign)
    counts = [len(v) for v in new_assign]
    assert sorted(counts) == sorted(balanced(P, C_NEW)), counts
    print("%-16s %-26s %-16d %.1f%%" % ("Cooperative(%d 消费者)" % C_NEW,
                                        str(counts), moved, 100.0 * moved / P))
print()
new_assign, moved = sticky_move(P, C_OLD, 5, old_assign)
print("Cooperative 的新分配明细:", [(i, v) for i, v in enumerate(new_assign)])
print("-> Eager 每次 rebalance 全体停摆（%d/%d = 100%%）; "
      "Cooperative 只搬迁必要分区: 扩容到 5 个只需搬 2 个（16.7%%）, 到 6 个需搬 4 个（33.3%%）"
      % (P, P))
